Remark
[Integrability of the first boundary kernel] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0318 ↗ lem:chow-iii-normal-heat-kernel-derivative 1. ch24:24.37\group Boundary Layer Potentials

For $\alpha \in (1/2,1)$, the first iterated boundary kernel $M_1$ obeys \[ \int _0^\tau \! \int _{\partial \mathcal M}|M_1| \, d\mu _{g(\sigma )}\, d\sigma \le C\tau ^{1-\alpha }, \] and hence its first Picard increment has the same bound.
